options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: APWorld Version
options.doc:
Internal. Set during generation.
The version of the APWorld

options.name: Death Link Mode
options.doc:
-REQUIRES DEATHLINK-
Set DeathLink Mode.

Modes:
- Lose: Both players dying triggers DeathLink. Same in reverse.
- Per Player: Each player's death will trigger DeathLink. Receiving a DeathLink will kill a random player.

NOTE: Per Player will behave like Lose if playing singleplayer.

This option is ignored on older clients that don't support this feature
options.doc_fr:
- Demande la mort...
Définir le mode DeathLink.

Modes:
- Lose: Les deux joueurs mourants déclenchent DeathLink. Même chose à l'envers.
- Per Player: La mort de chaque joueur déclenchera DeathLink. La réception d'un DeathLink tuera un joueur aléatoire.

NOTE: Par joueur se comportera comme Perdre si vous jouez seul.

Cette option est ignorée sur les clients plus âgés qui ne supportent pas cette fonctionnalité

options.name: Early Parry
options.doc:
Make Parry be placed early in the multiworld.
This may prevent early BK.
NOTE: This is on regardless in single player multiworlds.

options.name: Loadout Mixup Any Item

options.name: DLC
options.doc: Set whether or not to use Delicious Last Course content (Requires owning the DLC).

options.name: Mode
options.doc:
Set the mode of the randomizer which includes goal.
NOTE: If DLC is not enabled, picking DLC modes will pick a random mode from the base game instead.

options.name: Expert Mode
options.doc: Set the boss difficulty to expert.

options.name: Start Weapon
options.doc:
Choose weapon to start with.
NOTE: If DLC is not enabled, picking DLC weapons will pick a random base game weapon instead.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez une arme pour commencer.
NOTE: Si DLC n'est pas activé, le choix d'armes DLC choisira plutôt une arme de base aléatoire.

options.name: Weapon Mode
options.doc:
Set how the weapons are shuffled in the pool.
Options:
- Normal: EX is part of the weapon you receive (vanilla behavior).
- Progressive: turns the weapons in the pool into progressive weapons (plane has a separate EX item).
- EX Separate makes each weapon's EX ability a separate item.
- ... Except Start: makes the start weapon have normal behavior.
Notes:
- "Progressive" means that weapon EX is unlocked from having two of the same weapon.
- A weapon EX item without the base weapon will give you a weapon that only can do EX shots.

options.name: Contract Requirements
options.doc:
Set the amount of contracts needed to confront King Dice and, ultimately, the devil.
The required contracts for the die houses are evenly distributed.

options.name: Contract Goal Requirements
options.doc:
Set the amount of contracts needed for goal.
Note: Cannot be lower than Contract Requirements

options.name: Starting Max Health
options.doc:
Set starting max health.
NOTE: Health cannot be any higher than 9, so health charms would be less useful at higher health amounts.

options.name: Starting Max Health
options.doc:
Set starting max health for Player 2. Set to 0 to use Player 1's max health.
NOTE: Health cannot be any higher than 9, so health charms would be less useful at higher health amounts.

options.name: Level Shuffle
options.doc:
Shuffle the Boss and Run n' Gun levels.
Bosses and Run n' Guns are shuffled within their own group.
Note: Be careful with this option! This can easily break generation if used with plando.

options.name: Shuffle King Dice Bosses
options.doc:
Shuffle the King Dice mini-bosses.
This option is independent of Level Shuffle.

options.name: Level Shuffle Seed
options.doc:
Seed for Level Shuffle.
Leave blank to use a seed based on the multiworld's seed.

options.name: Level Placements
options.doc:
Define which levels will be placed in which spots when shuffling the levels.
Note: Some levels cannot be shuffled, and some levels cannot be placed in specific spots.
Key: original, Value: new
options.doc_fr:
Définissez quels niveaux seront placés dans quels endroits au moment de braquer les niveaux.
Note: Certains niveaux ne peuvent pas être mélangés, et certains niveaux ne peuvent pas être placés dans des endroits précis.
Key: original, Valeur: nouveau

options.name: Free Move Isles
options.doc: Allow all the levels on each island to be freely accessible without completing a previous level first.
options.doc_fr: Permettre à tous les niveaux de chaque île d'être librement accessibles sans avoir terminé un niveau précédent en premier.

options.name: Logic
options.doc:
-HARD LOGIC WORKS, BUT IS INCOMPLETE-
Set the logic mode.
Hard: Use more difficult logic that may require more skillful actions without specific items.
options.doc_fr:
- Les travaux logiques, mais est incomplétée...
Réglez le mode logique.
Hard: Utilisez une logique plus difficile qui peut exiger des actions plus habiles sans éléments spécifiques.

options.name: Randomize Abilities
options.doc: Randomize essential abilities like Crouch, Parry, Dash, etc.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
Enable DeathLink. When you die, everyone dies. Of course the reverse is true too.
In Cuphead, this only applies while you are in a level.
options.doc_html: Enable DeathLink. When you die, everyone dies. Of course the reverse is true too. In Cuphead, this only applies while you are in a level.

options.name: Death Link Grace Count
options.doc:
-REQUIRES DEATHLINK-
Set DeathLink Grace Count. Each "Grace" grants you a free Death without triggering DeathLink.
options.doc_fr:
- Demande la mort...
Définir DeathLink Grace Count. Chaque "Grace" vous accorde une Mort gratuite sans déclencher DeathLink.

options.name: [DLC] Ingredient Requirements
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
Set the amount of ingredients needed to confront Saltbaker.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
Définir la quantité d'ingrédients nécessaires pour affronter Saltbaker.

options.name: [DLC] Ingredient Goal Requirements
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
Set the amount of ingredients needed for goal.
Note: Cannot be lower than Ingredient Requirements
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
Définir la quantité d'ingrédients nécessaires pour atteindre l'objectif.
Note: Ne peut pas être inférieur aux exigences de l'ingrédient

options.name: [DLC] Ms. Chalice
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
Enable Ms. Chalice and the Astral Cookie.
Options:
- Disabled: The cookie is disabled and cannot be obtained (Ms. Chalice is disabled).
- Start: The cookie is available at the start of the game.
- Vanilla: The cookie is obtained at the start of the DLC (Vanilla Behavior).
- Randomized: The cookie is in the item pool. Starting the DLC is a check.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
Activez Mme Chalice et le cookie Astral.
Options:
- Disabled: Le cookie est désactivé et ne peut être obtenu (Mme Chalice est désactivée).
- Start: Le cookie est disponible au début du jeu.
- Vanilla: Le cookie est obtenu au début du DLC (Vanilla Behavior).
- Randomized: Le cookie est dans le pool d'articles. Démarrer le DLC est un chèque.

options.name: [DLC] Curse Mode
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
Set how the cursed and devine relic is handled.

Modes:
- Off: Broken Relic is removed from the game
- Vanilla: Broken Relic is in pool. The graveyard and getting the devine relic is excluded from logic.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
Définissez comment la relique maudite et devine est gérée.

Modes:
- Off: Broken Relic est retiré du jeu
- Vanilla: Broken Relic est dans la piscine. Le cimetière et l'obtention de la relique devine sont exclus de la logique.

options.name: Boss Secret Checks
options.doc:
Also include beating the secret phases that certain bosses have as checks.
The boss levels include: Botanic Panic, Pyramid Peril, Dramatic Fanatic, and Doggone Dogfight (DLC).
The secret phases are generally more difficult than the normal fight.
options.doc_fr:
Inclure également de battre les phases secrètes que certains patrons ont comme contrôles.
The boss levels include: Panique botanique, péril pyramide, fanatique dramatique et dogfight Doggone (DLC).
Les phases secrètes sont généralement plus difficiles que le combat normal.

options.name: Boss Grade Checks
options.doc:
Enable grade checks for Boss Levels.
NOTE: S Grade option will be treated as A+ Grade if Expert Mode is disabled.

options.name: Run n' Gun Grade Checks
options.doc:
Enable grade checks for Run n' Gun levels.
Pacifist: Beat the level without killing any monsters (not easy).

options.name: Silverworth Quest
options.doc:
Enable the Silverworth Quest check.
This means that you will have to beat 15 levels with at least an A- Grade in order to get this check.

options.name: Pacifist Quest
options.doc:
Enable the Pacifist Quest check.
This means that you will have to beat all 6 Run n' Gun levels without beating any enemies (not easy).

options.name: King Dice BossSanity
options.doc:
---NOT YET IMPLEMENTED---
Enable checks for beating the King Dice mini-bosses.
There is an indicator for which mini-bosses you defeated.
options.doc_fr:
- Non, pas encore.
Activer les contrôles pour battre les mini-bosses King Dice.
Il y a un indicateur pour lequel mini-bosses vous avez vaincu.

options.name: [DLC] The King's Leap
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
Choose how to handle the locations of The King's Leap.
Gauntlet is the run where you have to defeat all the King's Leap bosses in succession.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
Choisissez comment gérer les emplacements de Leap du Roi.
Gauntlet est la course où vous devez vaincre tous les patrons du Roi en succession.

options.name: [DLC] The King's Leap P. Sugar
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES THE KING'S LEAP-
Allow P. Sugar to be used in the King's Leap levels. Vanilla behavior only allows Parry.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
- Demande au roi...
Permettre à P. Sucre d'être utilisé dans les niveaux de fuite du Roi. Le comportement de la vanille ne permet que Parry.

options.name: [DLC] Boss Chalice Checks
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES CHALICE-
Enable checks for defeating each boss as Ms. Chalice.
Separate makes Chalice checks separate from level completion checks.
Grade Required has the set grade check requirement for bosses.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
- C'est un problème.
Permettre des vérifications pour vaincre chaque patron comme Mme Chalice.
Les vérifications de Chalice sont séparées des vérifications de niveau.
Le niveau requis est le niveau requis pour les patrons.

options.name: [DLC] Run n' Gun Chalice Checks
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES CHALICE-
Enable checks for completing each run n' gun as Ms. Chalice.
Separate makes Chalice checks separate from level completion checks.
Grade Required has the set grade check requirement for run n' guns.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
- C'est un problème.
Activer les vérifications pour chaque tir n' comme Mme Chalice.
Les vérifications de Chalice sont séparées des vérifications de niveau.
Le niveau requis a l'exigence de la vérification de la qualité définie pour les canons n'.

options.name: [DLC] King Dice Chalice Checks
options.doc:
--NOT YET IMPLEMENTED--
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES CHALICE-
-REQUIRES KING DICE BOSSSANITY-
Enable checks for completing King Dice Bossanity checks as Ms. Chalice.
options.doc_fr:
- Pas encore mis en œuvre...
- DLC seulement...
- C'est un problème.
- C'est une bonne idée.
Permettre des vérifications pour remplir les vérifications de Bossanité King Dice comme Mme Chalice.

options.name: [DLC] Chess Chalice Checks
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES CHALICE-
-REQUIRES THE KING'S LEAP-
Enable checks for completing The King's Leap checks as Ms. Chalice.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
- C'est un problème.
- Demande au roi...
Autoriser les vérifications pour remplir les vérifications du feuillet du Roi en tant que Mme Chalice.

options.name: [DLC] Cactus Girl Quest
options.doc:
-DLC ONLY-
-REQUIRES CHALICE-
Enable the Cactus Girl Quest (aka Ms. Chalice Quest) check.
This means that you will have to beat EVERY boss as Ms. Chalice (tedious) for a single check.
You can talk to the Cactus Girl to know which bosses you need to defeat still.
options.doc_fr:
- DLC seulement...
- C'est un problème.
Activez la vérification Cactus Girl Quest (alias Mme Chalice Quest).
Cela signifie que vous devrez battre TOUS les patrons comme Mme Chalice pour un seul chèque.
Vous pouvez parler à la fille Cactus pour savoir quels patrons vous devez vaincre encore.

options.name: Extra Coins
options.doc: Set extra coins in the item pool.

options.name: Max Health Upgrades
options.doc:
Set number of max health upgrades in the pool.
NOTE: Health cannot be any higher than 9, so health charms would be less useful at higher health amounts.

options.name: Minimum Filler Items
options.doc:
Set the minimum amount of filler items that should exist in this world.
NOTE: If there are not enough locations, some coins will be compressed into packs of 2 or 3 to make space.

options.name: Traps

---NOT YET IMPLEMENTED ON CLIENT---
Set Trap percentage for filler items.
options.doc_fr:
- Non, pas encore.
Définir le pourcentage de piège pour les éléments de remplissage.

options.name: [DLC] Chalice Items Separate
options.doc:
---NOT YET IMPLEMENTED---
-DLC ONLY-
Make certain items seperate for when playing as Ms. Chalice.
Options:
- Core Items: Core items like plane and supers.
- Abilities: Abilities including parry.

With parry for Ms. Chalice, the Parry item is replaced with Progressive Dash.
Progressive Dash has two levels: 1. Dash only, 2. Dash with Parry.

Note: Chalice Double Jump is randomized regardless of this option if Randomize Abilities is on.
options.doc_fr:
- Non, pas encore.
- DLC seulement...
Faites en sorte que certains éléments soient séparés pour jouer en tant que Mme Chalice.
Options:
- Core Items: Les objets de base comme l'avion et les supers.
- Abilities: Capacités, y compris les paris.

Avec Parry pour Mme Chalice, l'article Parry est remplacé par Progressive Dash.
Dash progressif a deux niveaux: 1. Dash seulement, 2. Dash avec Parry.

Note: Chalice Double Jump est randomisé quelle que soit cette option si Randomize Capacités est activé.

options.name: DuckLock PlatDrop
options.doc:
Allow the dropping-down-platforms-without-duck-by-using-aim-lock exploit.
This option re-enables that bug that the mod had before alpha02.
This "feature" is purely client-side and does not affect logic.
options.doc_fr:
Permettre l'exploitation des plates-formes décrochage-décrochage-sans-décrochage-par-utilisation-aim-lock.
Cette option permet de réactiver ce bogue que le mod avait avant alpha02.
Cette « caractéristique » est purement axée sur le client et n'affecte pas la logique.
